description:
Whimsical Scientists 🚀🌍

We're a women's multidisciplinary field team, dealt with hundred thousand of data from field work. Yes, everything is statistics for us, even the logo is created using Excel 🧮!
summary: Become an Earth detective with Whimsical Earth Adventures, a free web game built with AI assistance for curious minds of all ages. Join Whim, a space cat, to investigate NASA records of heat, rainfall, rising seas and more. Predict a trend, measure the change and see what the evidence supports. No clear trend is a valid finding too. Tackle daily cases, earn achievements and explore science in everyday language. You can also type, paste or load your own data to analyse locally on your device. No login needed. Start with a place that matters to you.
details:
🌍 Details

  • Whimsical Earth Adventures turns NASA Earth data into detective cases.
  • Built for NASA Space Apps 2026: “Be An Earth System Trend Detective!”
  • Includes 276 cases across 21 locations, exploring heat, rainfall, drought, and rising seas.

🎮 How it works?

  • 📍 Choose a place and environmental concern.
  • 📈 Watch NASA records unfold year by year.
  • 🤔 Predict: rising, falling, or no clear trend.
  • 📏 Estimate the rate of change.
  • 🔬 Compare your prediction with statistical evidence.

🌱 Key Benefits & Impact

  • 🧠 Practises prediction, measurement, and critical thinking.
  • 🌍 Connects NASA data with local environmental questions.
  • 📚 Offers simple explanations and deeper scientific detail.
  • 🏫 Designed for learners, classrooms, and science outreach.

🛠️ Tech Stack

  • 💻 Interface: React, TypeScript, Vite, and D3.
  • ⚙️ Processing and checks: Python and SciPy.
  • 🛰️ Data: NASA POWER and NASA-SSH sea level records.
  • 🧪 Analysis: Mann–Kendall testing, Sen’s slope, and 95% confidence intervals.
  • 🌐 Hosting: GitHub Pages with openly available source code.

💡 Innovation Highlights

  • 🎯 Rewards predictions supported by evidence.
  • ⚖️ Treats “no clear trend” as a valid result.
  • 🐱 Combines character guides, daily challenges, and passport stamps.
  • 🎵 Turns annual data values into sound.
  • 🔐 Lets users analyse their own CSV data locally.
  • 🔍 Explains uncertainty and limitations without claiming causes or forecasting the future.
